name: sdd-tdd-loop
description: Local task -> spec -> use cases -> red/green/refactor. A spec-driven + test-driven working loop with a plain-file task store; no board, no PR mechanics.

tasks_path.title: Task store
tasks_path.description: JSON file holding the local tasks. Replaces the board.

tracks_dir.title: Tracks directory
tracks_dir.description: Where a task's spec.md / contract.md / use-cases.json live.

spec_baseline.title: RF renumbering baseline
spec_baseline.description: "git" compares spec.md against git HEAD to catch renumbered RF/AC headers. "off" skips it (non-git projects).
